metadata.name: grafana
metadata.description: Grafana integration family. Concrete providers (grafana, grafana-kubernetes) implement subsets of these operations and declare it via IntegrationType.implemented_operations.

spec.description: Contract for any provider that adapts Grafana for Yggdrasil — covers HTTP API operations (ensure_folder/upsert_*) and Kubernetes installation.

operations.name: ensure_folder
operations.description: Idempotently ensure one Grafana folder exists with the desired metadata.

operations.name: upsert_datasource
operations.description: Idempotently upsert one Grafana data source.

operations.name: upsert_dashboard
operations.description: Idempotently upsert one Grafana dashboard JSON model.

operations.name: generate_installation
operations.description: Materialize a Grafana installation as raw Kubernetes objects.

operations.name: reconcile_installation
operations.description: Build a declarative reconciliation plan for a Grafana installation.

operations.name: discover_installation_state
operations.description: Return the currently known installation state for a Grafana blueprint.
